title: Guided rectified-flow sampling (method/guided_sampling.py), seed 0, 12 sampler steps
dataset: JonathanSickert/unbake; subset 1 / subset 2 = two disjoint sets of 10 inputs with every object once; reference values for these inputs are in baselines/results/

evaluation.uv: MAE / PSNR per channel on the covered texels, base color in sRGB; basecolor_mae_scale_invariant: prediction scaled per channel by the least-squares factor to the ground truth (linear) before the MAE (method/analyze.py)
evaluation.relit: TRELLIS.2 PBR renderer, the 7 environment maps that differ from the bake lighting, 4 views at 512x512 (baselines/evaluate_relit.py)

guided.settings: last 6 steps guided, 5 inner Adam steps, lr 0.05, lambda 0.1
